# streamsec_aws_scanner_hub (Resource)

Makes an AWS account's agentless volume scanner a hub: it also scans other AWS accounts in its regions, through the `StreamScannerSpokeRole` each of them creates (see the `streamsec_aws_scanner_hub_access` data source). Destroying it turns the hub off: each account goes back to its own scanner.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The security account's volume scanner also scans the dev and prod accounts.
resource "streamsec_aws_scanner_hub" "security" {
  account_id  = streamsec_aws_account.security.id
  coverage    = "selected"
  account_ids = [streamsec_aws_account.dev.id, streamsec_aws_account.prod.id]
}

# The shared-services account's scanner scans every other AWS account that has no
# scanner of its own and no other hub. Only one hub may cover "all".
resource "streamsec_aws_scanner_hub" "shared_services" {
  account_id = streamsec_aws_account.shared_services.id
  coverage   = "all"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) The Stream Security id of the hub's AWS account (`streamsec_aws_account.<name>.id`). Changing it replaces the resource.
- `coverage` (String) Which accounts the hub scans: `all` (every other AWS account without a scanner of its own in the region and not scanned by another hub) or `selected` (the accounts in `account_ids`). Only one hub may cover `all`.

### Optional

- `account_ids` (Set of String) The Stream Security ids of the AWS accounts the hub scans. Required when `coverage` is `selected` (an empty set scans none); must be unset or empty when `coverage` is `all`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# A scanner hub is imported by the Stream Security id of its AWS account.
terraform import streamsec_aws_scanner_hub.security 64f1c0ffee0123456789abcd
```
